title: Observability: token-level cost & latency metrics, tracing, dashboard and alert tuning
author: Priya Desai
description: Motivation: We need finer-grained observability to correlate per-request token cost and latency with KV cache behavior and trace spans so product teams can diagnose cost regressions and high-latency tails. This PR adds token-level cost/latency metrics, propagates token-level tracing fields through the serving runtime, and ships a Grafana dashboard + alert tuning to reduce noise while catching real regressions. Changes are backward-compatible and opt-in via feature flag. The description below summarizes the technical work, testing, and rollout plan.
commits_summary: feat(metrics): add token_cost_total, token_latency_histogram; feat(tracing): attach token_ids and cache_hit metadata to spans; docs(dashboards): new token cost/latency Grafana dashboard; perf: low-overhead aggregation path for hot codepath; fix(ci): e2e test flake fixes; chore: alert thresholds tuning and runbook updates
review_comments: Lena: Great end-to-end here. Two asks: 1) ensure token ids are redacted in logs by default and 2) confirm histogram bucket boundaries (suggest adding a lower bucket).
Author (Priya): switched to hashed token IDs in traces and logs; added finer-grained low-latency buckets (0-1ms,1-5ms) and documented rationale in token_metrics.md.
Marco: CI flake observed on e2e when running with small batch sizes - looks like a race in cache warmup. Can we add a short backoff?
Author: added retry/backoff in cache init path and added deterministic seed to the test harness to remove nondeterminism. CI green locally.
Aisha: Alert tuning LGTM but please add a short suppression window for transient deploy noise (5 minutes).
Author: added suppression_window: 5m to token_alert_rules.yaml and included runbook note to escalate if suppression masks repeated breaches.
release_notes: Added token-level cost and latency metrics, token-aware tracing, Grafana token cost/latency dashboard, and tuned alert rules with default suppression to reduce noise. Opt-in via feature flag. No breaking changes.
